name: ChatGPT
short_desc: External: Connect your ChatGPT subscription once; your agent on this server uses it.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Connect your ChatGPT Plus or Pro subscription to your Wizard server once. This app owns and renews the ChatGPT login in its app-data folder. Stock Hermes receives only a box-local bearer and calls this app for models and quota. Connecting leaves the default Hermes model unchanged.

form_fields.label: Page password (optional)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty on a Tailscale-only server. If set (use 16+ characters), your browser asks for it (any username) before showing this page.

form_fields.label: Hermes Agent dashboard username
form_fields.hint: Filled in automatically from your Hermes Agent app. Used only to register the private model endpoint; login stays in this app.

form_fields.label: Hermes Agent dashboard password
form_fields.hint: Filled in automatically from your Hermes Agent app (the same dashboard password). Used only for endpoint registration, never for ChatGPT login or model calls.

form_fields.label: Hermes Agent dashboard address (optional)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty to use the Hermes Agent app (http://hermes-agent:9119). Set it only if your agent's dashboard runs elsewhere.
